name: platform-tls-verify-policy
title: Platform reverse HTTPS TLS verification policy
description: Configure reverse HTTPS verification per platform with strict defaults, reusable CA certificates, explicit BYPASS controls, direct/routed parity, revocation, and failure attribution.
creator: killbus
notes: Correction after implementation review: TLS verification is one optional setting per custom platform, matching Resin's existing whole-platform configuration model. The earlier exact host:port rule scope was an assistant-proposed risk-reduction baseline made without a real usage requirement; it is withdrawn. Absence means system VERIFY. The built-in Default platform is always VERIFY and cannot persist a policy. TRUST_CUSTOM_CA augments system roots with one immutable imported bundle while preserving hostname/SNI; BYPASS is an explicit platform-wide exception with reason and optional expiry. Direct and routed reverse HTTPS share the decision; forward, CONNECT, SOCKS5, probes, HTTP, and other platforms remain isolated. CABundleRegistry still owns import, canonicalization, fingerprint dedupe, integrity and reference-aware deletion; PlatformTLSPolicy owns singular platform policy, CAS/history, publication, expiry and revocation. Request target remains normalized for dialing/SNI/audit, not policy matching. History is PEM-free and outlives active/platform rows. Only explicit NodeTransportFailure evidence permits negative node health. Resin has no user/RBAC identity and audit must not invent one. The fork-only v1.3.0 history is being replaced via fixup/autosquash, so migration 000010 is corrected in place rather than adding a compatibility migration.
